evidence.reason: The tip still caches the session-creation promise in `terminalSessions` before it settles and never deletes it on rejection. If setup throws at any awaited step (including the phase revalidations at lines 227/248/252/254, `realpath`, `mkdir`, or `writeFile`), later `terminalSession` calls for that token return the same rejected promise after their own validation. Because the map is keyed only by token, later terminal/cleanup attempts cannot retry or clean up any partially created `cq-address-terminal-*` directory. This is an implementation defect in existing behavior, not a new requirement.
